svg.title: One directory per algorithm
svg.desc: An algorithm directory, one defineVisualization call and a catalog card. Steps: 1. Each algorithm is one self-contained directory. 2. One defineVisualization call registers it. 3. A catalog card and a hash route put it on the site. 4. Shared instruments do the playback and drawing. Sources: Algorithm Visualizer README.

text.tspan: Each algorithm is one self-contained directory.
A catalog card and a hash route put it on the site.
Shared instruments do the playback and drawing.
An algorithm directory, one defineVisualization call and a catalog
